SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.status, (ve.id IS NOT NULL) AS effective, d.order_num, d.remark, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.created_by, d.updated_by FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN v_dept_effective ve ON ve.id = d.id
d.status = #{query.status}
AND
d.id IN ( SELECT dc.ancestor_id FROM dept_closure dc INNER JOIN sys_dept m ON m.id = dc.descendant_id WHERE m.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR m.dept_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY d.order_num, d.id

SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, p.dept_code AS parent_dept_code, p.dept_name AS parent_dept_name, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.status, (ve.id IS NOT NULL) AS effective, d.order_num, d.remark, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.created_by, d.updated_by FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_dept p ON d.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN v_dept_effective ve ON ve.id = d.id
d.status = #{query.status}
AND
d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.deptName}, '%')
AND
d.dept_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.deptCode}, '%')
ORDER BY d.order_num, d.id

SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_code, d.status, d.order_num, d.remark, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.created_by, d.updated_by FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.dept_code IN
#{deptCode}

WITH subtree AS (SELECT dc.descendant_id FROM dept_closure dc WHERE dc.ancestor_id = #{deptId}) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN subtree s ON ud.dept_id = s.descendant_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_post p INNER JOIN subtree s ON p.dept_id = s.descendant_id)
